Builds an initial bracket from a lookup table scaled by |a4| * this[3903], clamps it to [0,128], then iteratively bisects: at each endpoint it evaluates the force via a sign-selected interpolated lookup table (positive table this[3855]/this[3856] or negative table this[3871]/this[3872]) combined with slip terms built from a2, a3 and a4. Stops when the endpoint forces bracket a sign change, expands the bracket by a5 otherwise, and returns the interpolated root, or a limit (0.0/128.0) on unordered (NaN) comparisons.
